meta.title: mem20 Memory Surface — ranked entry point for the 49 memory_* tools
meta.lane: UX Research — desktop design (wireframes A-D -> clickable prototype)

house_numbers.note: mem20 house positioning numbers. Not investment guidance; market sizing is a product-positioning input, not financial advice.

sources.tool_surface: AST extraction of mt.Tool(name=...) across mcp/ and mcp_server_dir/ in the canonical repo (extract_memory_surface.py) — 49 memory_* of 257 total
sources.personas: mem20 design research, personas block (shares + opportunity scores): Agent Builder 30% / 16.4, Platform Engineer 24% / 11.5, Domain Integrator 22% / 15.1, Memory Operator 24% / 14.2
sources.wireframes: Wireframes A Server Connection, B Memory Explorer, C Store/Recall Inspector, D Tool Surface Navigator

honesty.what_is_measured: Tool names, titles and descriptions are read from the repository. Counts (257 / 49) are counted, not asserted.
honesty.what_is_declared: Cluster membership, the persona-affinity matrix and per-tool tiers are DECLARED DESIGN INPUTS, not measured user preference. They make the 49-tool wall navigable; they are a hypothesis for the usability test to falsify.
honesty.instrument: The prototype carries the usability-test task set, per-task timer and error log, so these rankings can be replaced by observed behaviour rather than kept as opinion.

derivation.formula: score(c) = sum over personas p of (share_p * opportunity_p * affinity_pc)
derivation.affinity_scale: 1.0 primary surface for that persona, 0.6 supporting, 0.25 adjacent
derivation.tie_break: higher raw score, then larger tool count, then cluster id (deterministic)

clusters.name: Core Recall & Store
clusters.blurb: Write a fact, get it back. The four recall modes plus context assembly and entity probes.
clusters.start_here: memory_store then memory_recall — one round-trip proves fidelity before anything else is learned.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.title: Store Memory
tools.description: Store a fact in mem20's persistent memory system.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.title: Recall Memory
tools.description: Search and recall facts from mem20's memory system.

tools.name: memory_recall_hybrid
tools.title: Hybrid Memory Recall
tools.description: Hybrid BM25 + vector search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optional cross-encoder reranking.

tools.name: memory_recall_semantic
tools.title: Semantic Memory Recall
tools.description: Pure vector-based semantic search using embeddings.

tools.name: memory_recall_graph
tools.title: Graph Memory Recall
tools.description: Knowledge graph traversal with multi-hop entity resolution.

tools.name: memory_context_window
tools.title: Context Window
tools.description: Get memories relevant to the current context.

tools.name: memory_probe
tools.title: Probe Entity
tools.description: Get all facts about a specific entity.

tools.name: memory_related
tools.title: Find Related Entities
tools.description: Find entities structurally adjacent or connected to a given entity.

tools.name: memory_reason
tools.title: Reason Across Entities
tools.description: Compositional reasoning across multiple entities.

tools.name: memory_graph_traverse
tools.title: Graph Traversal
tools.description: Traverse the memory graph from a starting entity.

clusters.name: Trust & Epistemics
clusters.blurb: The grounded-vs-simulated boundary: tag it, gate promotion, audit provenance, veto plans built on inference.
clusters.start_here: memory_set_epistemic_status at capture, memory_audit_contamination on a schedule — never promote without a gate.

tools.name: memory_set_epistemic_status
tools.title: Set Epistemic Status
tools.description: Set epistemic status tag (observed, inferred, imagined, user_stated, hypothesis, agent_generated).

tools.name: memory_promote
tools.title: Promote Simulated -> Grounded
tools.description: Promote a simulated fact into grounded memory only through an explicit gate.

tools.name: memory_simulate_store
tools.title: Store Simulated (Partitioned)
tools.description: Store simulated or imagined content into the separate simulated partition.

tools.name: memory_list_simulated
tools.title: List Simulated Partition
tools.description: List active (non-quarantined, non-expired) simulated facts from the separate partition.

tools.name: memory_quarantine_simulated
tools.title: Decay / Quarantine Simulated
tools.description: Quarantine simulated facts whose TTL decay window has expired.

tools.name: memory_audit_contamination
tools.title: Audit Memory Contamination
tools.description: Periodic provenance audit: detect any high-confidence memory whose ultimate provenance is unverified.

tools.name: memory_assess_confidence
tools.title: Assess Memory Confidence
tools.description: Explicitly set or update the confidence score for a fact.

tools.name: memory_detect_gaps
tools.title: Detect Knowledge Gaps
tools.description: Detect knowledge gaps for a topic: areas with low confidence or missing coverage.

tools.name: memory_epistemic_veto
tools.title: Epistemic Veto
tools.description: Epistemic-layer veto: refuse a plan that rests primarily on unvalidated simulated or imagined memory.

tools.name: memory_self_audit
tools.title: Self Audit
tools.description: Metacognitive self-audit: evaluate own knowledge quality and identify biases.

clusters.name: Governance & Isolation
clusters.blurb: Give each team its own scope, share deliberately through ACLs, screen content for PII before it lands.
clusters.start_here: memory_namespace_create before the first write, memory_scan_pii wired into the write path.

tools.name: memory_namespace_create
tools.title: Create Memory Namespace
tools.description: Create a namespaced memory scope for multi-agent isolation.

tools.name: memory_namespace_list
tools.title: List Memory Namespaces
tools.description: List all memory namespaces and their ACLs.

tools.name: memory_scan_pii
tools.title: Scan for PII / Secrets
tools.description: Scan content for PII, secrets, API keys and other sensitive data.

tools.name: memory_shared_store
tools.title: Store in Shared Memory
tools.description: Store a fact in a shared namespace with ACL checking.

tools.name: memory_shared_recall
tools.title: Recall from Shared Memory
tools.description: Recall facts from a shared namespace with ACL checking.

clusters.name: Curation & Lifecycle
clusters.blurb: Keep the store honest over time: dedupe, reconcile contradictions, decay, rate, and walk the timeline.
clusters.start_here: memory_timeline to see what is there, memory_contradict to find what fights, memory_deduplicate before the store grows.

tools.name: memory_timeline
tools.title: Memory Timeline
tools.description: View memories in chronological order.

tools.name: memory_contradict
tools.title: Find Contradictions
tools.description: Find facts that make conflicting claims about a topic.

tools.name: memory_deduplicate
tools.title: Deduplicate Memories
tools.description: Find and remove duplicate memories.

tools.name: memory_decay
tools.title: Memory Decay
tools.description: Apply time-based decay to memory relevance.

tools.name: memory_feedback
tools.title: Rate Fact
tools.description: Rate a fact helpful or unhelpful to train trust scores.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.title: Consolidate Memories
tools.description: Auto-merge similar memories to reduce redundancy.

tools.name: memory_reinforce
tools.title: Reinforce Memory
tools.description: Boost the importance of a memory.

tools.name: memory_cluster
tools.title: Cluster Memories
tools.description: Group related memories into clusters.

tools.name: memory_auto_consolidate
tools.title: Auto Consolidation
tools.description: Cluster similar memories and generate higher-level summaries.

tools.name: memory_mood_tag
tools.title: Mood Tag
tools.description: Tag memories with mood or emotion.

clusters.name: Ingestion
clusters.blurb: Bring domain artefacts in: PDF, code, image, audio, and the entities inside them.
clusters.start_here: memory_ingest_pdf or memory_ingest_code — one artefact end to end, then memory_entity_extract.

tools.name: memory_ingest_pdf
tools.title: Ingest PDF
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF file and store it as memories.

tools.name: memory_ingest_code
tools.title: Ingest Code (AST Parsing)
tools.description: Parse code files with tree-sitter and extract structural information.

tools.name: memory_ingest_image
tools.title: Ingest Image (OCR)
tools.description: Extract text from an image using OCR and store it as memories.

tools.name: memory_ingest_audio
tools.title: Ingest Audio (Transcription)
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file using Whisper and store it as memories.

tools.name: memory_entity_extract
tools.title: Entity Extraction
tools.description: Extract entities and relationships from text using spaCy or an LLM.

clusters.name: Ops & Diagnostics
clusters.blurb: Is it healthy, how big is it, can I move it, what fires automatically.
clusters.start_here: memory_status for a health read, memory_stats for size and shape.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.title: Memory Status
tools.description: Get mem20 memory system status and stats.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.title: Memory Statistics
tools.description: Get detailed memory system statistics.

tools.name: memory_export
tools.title: Export Memories
tools.description: Export memories to various formats.

tools.name: memory_import
tools.title: Import Memories
tools.description: Import memories from a file.

tools.name: memory_triggers
tools.title: Memory Triggers
tools.description: Set up event-based memory triggers.

clusters.name: Pinned Blocks
clusters.blurb: Memory immune to pruning: pin the block that must always be in context, and unpin it when it stops being true.
clusters.start_here: memory_pin_block for the invariants, memory_list_pinned_blocks to audit what is exempt from pruning.

tools.name: memory_pin_block
tools.title: Pin Memory Block
tools.description: Pin a memory block as a core reference, immune to pruning and supersede.

tools.name: memory_list_pinned_blocks
tools.title: List Pinned Blocks
tools.description: List all pinned memory blocks.

tools.name: memory_get_pinned_block
tools.title: Get Pinned Block
tools.description: Get a specific pinned block.

tools.name: memory_unpin_block
tools.title: Unpin Memory Block
tools.description: Unpin a previously pinned block.
